February 3, 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,
    I forward herewith for your information tabulated
statement relating to the arrest by the Municipal Police
of a communist named Sung Kwan Soo (沈管苏,) at 10.55 p.m.
January 26, 1934 at No.308 Tin Yi Li, Jansen Road.
    The accused appeared on remand before the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on January 31, 1934
and was ordered to be handed over to the Chinese authorities.
                        Yours sincerely,
                        （签名）

Monsieur R. Sarly,
    Chief of the Political Section,
        French Police Headquarters.

Proceedings
Application is hereby made for the above named
person to be handed over to the P.S.B. by whom
he is wanted on a charge of being a communist.

Mr.T.Y.Chang appeared for the Police.
Mr.Tseu Ming Gee appeared for the S.P.S.B.

Mr.Chang:-The Representative of the S.P.S.B. asked me to
request the court to hear all the seven communistic cases in camera.
(Application granted)

Mr.Chang continued:-During the period of remand there
has been no further evidence found by the Police.

Rep.Tsiang Au Hui:-I have brought a despatch to this court
asking for extradition of the accused. (produced) The accused is
known to be one of the members of the Communistic Party. He is the
chief of the Propaganda Department of the Communistic Party in the
Eastern district of Shanghai. The informer is not in court today.

Accused:-I am a workman. I do not know anything of
Communism. It is true that there is a soar on my neck.

Decision
Accused to be handed over to Public Safety Bureau
for trial.

Tsiang Zao Liang.

兹申请将上述人员移交给市公安局，该局以其涉嫌为共产党人为由对其通缉。

Date 29/1/34
Judge Kyung.

Accused Sung Kwan Soo ( ) Age 25. Unemployed.

Charge Application is hereby made for the detention for further
enquiries of the above named person who was arrested at 10.55 p.m
26/1/34, at No 308 Tin Yi Li, Jansen road, and is wanted by the
P.S.B Nantao, on a charge of being a communist.

HIGH COURT. A.M.

Proceedings. Mr T.Y.Chang appeared for the Police.
Mr Chang:- At about 10.55.a.m. on the 26/1/34, the accused
was arrested at No.308. Tin Yih Li, off Jansen Road, on the author-
ity of a warrant issued by the 1st Special District Court, at the
request of the S.P.S.B. The warrant stated that the wanted person
had a scar on his neck about two inches long. When the accused was
questioned he denied being a communist and stated that he came to
Shanghai find employment. The accused was identified by an informer
of the S.P.S.B. as being a communist. (Statement Produced). Nothing
of an incriminating nature was seized from the accused's room.
Accused:- I was employed by the Shanghai Power Co, since
23rd, November 1933. I left the Shanghai Power Co, about three weeks
ago. I admit having a scar on my neck(shown to the judge). I am
not a member of the Communist Party.
Tsiang Au Yu. Rep. of the S.P.S.B:- We received information
to the effect that the accused was the Chief of the Propaganda Dept
of the Communist Party, in the Eastern Area. The accused knows the
female Ling Su Ying, arrested by the detectives attached to Wayside
Police Station.
Accused :- I do not know the female arrested by the police
attached to Wayside Station.

Decision. Remand to 31/1/34. 1.30.p.m. for trial. Accused to be detained in
custody.

G.L.

日期 34年1月29日
Kyung 法官。

被告 沈管苏（ ） 年龄 25岁。失业。

指控 兹申请拘留上述人员以作进一步调查，该人于34年1月26日晚上10点55分在詹森路（Jansen road）天一里308号被捕，南市公安局以其涉嫌为共产党人为由对其通缉。

高等法院。上午。

诉讼程序。T.Y. Chang 先生代表警方出庭。
Chang 先生:- 34年1月26日上午10点55分左右，被告在詹森路旁天一里308号被捕，依据的是第一特区地方法院应上海市公安局请求签发的逮捕令。逮捕令指出，被通缉者颈部有一条约两英寸长的疤痕。在对被告进行讯问时，他否认自己是共产党人，并称他来上海是为了找工作。上海市公安局的一名线人指认被告为共产党人。（出示陈述）。从被告房间内未搜获任何具有定罪性质的物品。
被告:- 我自1933年11月23日起受雇于上海电力公司。大约三周前我离开了上海电力公司。我承认脖子上有疤痕（向法官展示）。我不是共产党党员。
上海市公安局代表 蒋欧宇:- 我们收到情报，称被告是共产党东部地区宣传部主任。被告认识被附属于韦斯特盖特捕房（Wayside Police Station）的侦探逮捕的女性凌素英（Ling Su Ying）。
被告:- 我不认识被韦斯特盖特捕房警察逮捕的那名女性。

裁决。还押至34年1月31日下午1点30分受审。被告予以羁押。

G.L.

lin Rd Stn.           26-1-34                   Clerk Tao Chin Y(

My name is Sung Kwan Soo, 25, native of Chingkiang. I am
married and at present unemployed.
    In my native place I was living with my father, mother,
three brothers, two sisters and a sister-in-law. From the age
of 12 years to 18 years, I was studying under a private tutor,
and from 18 to 25 years, I was working on a farm of 100 mow
of land owned by my brothers and myself.
    During September 1933 I decided to come to Shanghai in
search of employment. On the 17th of that month I arrived in
Shanghai and resided at 306 Rue Fralupt, French Concession,
obtaining a living by manufacturing and selling face cream.
On 23rd of November I moved to 308 Tin Yu Li, Jansen Road, and
on the 26th of that month I obtained employment with the
Shanghai Power Company (during their strike) as a coolie; I
was employed there for about 22 days when I was paid off
because the S.P.C. commenced to reinstate their old workers.
Since leaving the Shanghai Power Company I have been unemployed
and have been kept by my wife who is employed at the Dah Kong
Cotton Mill, Yangtzepoo Road.
    I am not a communist and do not belong to any political
party.

                        Stated by Sung Kwan Soo.
pages.zh:
沈管苏
镇江                                      D. S. White.
榆林路捕房           34年1月26日                   书记员 Tao Chin Y(

我叫沈管苏，25岁，镇江人。我已婚，目前失业。
    在家乡，我与父亲、母亲、三个兄弟、两个姐妹和一个嫂子同住。从12岁到18岁，我在私塾读书，从18岁到25岁，我在我和兄弟们拥有的100亩土地上务农。
    1933年9月期间，我决定来上海找工作。当月17日我抵达上海，居住在法租界 Fralupt 路306号，靠制造和销售面霜为生。11月23日，我搬到了詹森路（Jansen Road）天裕里（Tin Yu Li）308号，当月26日，我在上海电力公司（正值罢工期间）找到了一份苦力的工作；我在那里工作了约22天，后因上海电力公司开始重新雇佣老员工而被解雇。自离开上海电力公司以来，我一直失业，由在杨树浦路大康纱厂工作的妻子供养。
    我不是共产党人，也不属于任何政党。

                        沈管苏陈述。
